svg.title: TrackFit system architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture of the Smart Fitness and Step Counter Flutter app: presentation, state, domain models, core services, local Hive persistence, Android platform and the build pipeline.

g.text: Smart Fitness & Step Counter — an offline-first, privacy-friendly Flutter app for Android
Sign in / up · OTP · password reset
Progress ring · live steps · weekly card
Local build → APK in releases/ → version control (APKs are git-ignored)

svg.text: Step, goal, weight and preference data never leaves the device · only map tiles use the network
